title: Air-fryer chicken wings with sweet potato wedges
description: Crispy smoky wings tossed in a buttery hot sauce, with air-fried sweet potato wedges.
freeze_note: Freeze the wings and wedges; warm the butter hot sauce and toss the wings in it after reheating.
draft_note: Draft quantities: adjust them in the app. Freeze the wings before saucing; re-crisp them in the air fryer.

steps.text: Pat the wings very dry and toss with the baking powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with the oil.
Air fry the wedges at 400F for 16 to 18 minutes, shaking halfway; keep warm.
Air fry the wings in one layer at 400F for 22 to 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and cooked through to the bone.
Melt the butter with the hot sauce in a small pan and toss the wings in it.
Divide the wings and wedges among 4 containers.
Cool, then refrigerate in the containers.
Reheat covered, stirring halfway, until hot all the way through.
